O(lym)PEC Record
12 Aug 2016: This club of oil producers is still a force to be reckoned with The 29th Olympic Games in Brazil are in full swing and records are falling daily. Not to be left behind, OPEC announced in their latest Monthly Oil Market Report record crude oil output for July 2016.
